item.title: Trump gives Iran 48 hours to open Strait of Hormuz as search continues for missing US pilot
item.summary: U_S_ President Donald Trump has again warned Tehran over his Monday deadline to open the crucial Strait of Hormuz and allow ship traffic to flow again, and Iran has responded by threatening to open “the gates of hell.”

item.title: A long Mideast war could take away from support for Ukraine, Zelenskyy tells the AP
item.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is concerned that a prolonged U.S.-Israeli war on Iran could erode America's support for Ukraine as Washington's global priorities shift

item.title: Aid groups warn Iran war is hindering food and medicine from reaching millions
item.summary: Aid groups are warning that the war in the Middle East has upended their ability to get food and medicine to millions in need and that more people will suffer if the violence continues

item.title: Collapse of Tokyo's aging cherry blossom trees raises safety concerns
item.summary: In Tokyo, the birthplace of Japan’s popular Somei Yoshino cherry blossom variety, many of the trees planted during the country’s postwar advancement of the 1960s are now getting old and frail

item.title: UK gathers more than 40 countries to plot ways of reopening the Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: Britain has accused Iran of holding the world’s economy hostage, as diplomats from more than 40 countries held talks on ways of reopening the Strait of Hormuz

item.title: Islamic State-linked rebels kill at least 43 in attack in eastern Congo
item.summary: Officials say rebels affiliated with the Islamic State group have killed at least 43 people in eastern Congo

item.title: Dutch police probe a small blast outside a pro-Israel Christian center
item.summary: Dutch police are investigating a small explosion outside a Christian center that promotes Israel

item.title: Pope Leo XIV celebrates first Easter vigil, calls for harmony and peace in a world torn by war
item.summary: Pope Leo XIV ushers in Easter with his first vigil service as pontiff at St. Peter’s Basilica

item.title: Choirs seek to protect a musical tradition little changed since Queen Elizabeth I
item.summary: A campaign is underway to protect England's choral music tradition, which has thrived for nearly 500 years

item.title: Operation to tow damaged Russian tanker off Libya fails due to weather
item.summary: Libyan authorities said the operation to tow a damaged Russian tanker adrift in the Mediterranean has failed due to bad weather
